rationale: The schema change requires `entity_id` to be treated as bytes in v2. The first edit converts the string output of `entity.entity_id` to a UTF-8 decoded string for consistency with the observation format (string). The second edit updates the construction of an Entity in v2 to use raw bytes (`b"py_101"`) instead of a string, as per the intended behavior. Both edits align with the explicit requirement to encode text identifiers on construction and decode them for observations.
assumptions: The `entity_id` field in v2 is always valid UTF-8 when observed (as per the schema change constraints).
No other implicit string-to-bytes conversions are needed elsewhere in the file, as the protobuf library handles serialization/deserialization internally.
